answers.name: a league value wins over the account default
a league that was never given targets inherits the account default
a league CLEARED to empty opts out and does NOT re-inherit
no league value and no account default is none, not an error
a league value REPLACES the account default whole rather than merging per position
an unknown position is dropped on both sides
a zero is dropped rather than stored — 'no target' and 'a target of zero' are one instruction
an all-zero league map is an opt-out, exactly like an empty one
a count above the ceiling is dropped, not clamped
